article_context: This body image illustrates the article’s everyday self-care advice: a warm shower or steam may temporarily ease the sensation of nasal congestion.
image_reading: An adult man stands in a tiled shower, seen from behind and in partial profile.
Water falls from the showerhead onto his shoulders and back; droplets run down his skin.
The shot is intimate but non-explicit, with the shower stream as the main visible moving element.

models.positive_prompt: Warm shower water falls steadily over the man's shoulders as he slowly lowers his head in quiet relief; fixed camera, ending with the water still streaming evenly over his relaxed back.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the shower stream begins immediately and continues as one steady physical process. The man makes a small, unhurried downward head movement and settles his shoulders beneath the water; keep the camera fixed on his upper back and profile. By the last frames he is calmly resting under the even stream, which remains clearly visible.

models.positive_prompt: The man gradually settles beneath the warm shower stream, water running continuously over his shoulders. Fixed view on his back; end with his relaxed posture held under the steady falling water.
models.scene_plan: For the full five seconds, make the falling water the continuous action. He subtly eases his shoulders and inclines his head while remaining in place, conveying quiet, practical relief. Use a fixed camera so the shower stream and his upper back stay the focal point. Reach the settled posture near the end with no new action afterward.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the man's back as the warm shower runs steadily over his shoulders; he gently lowers his head and settles into a relaxed posture, ending under the continuous stream.
